reason: Ruff config (.ruff.toml) selects no ANN rules and there is no mypy, so nothing enforces annotations; members such as prompt_builder.py and response_parser.py annotate returns, while the three outliers (client.py, evaluator.py, model_list.py) are ordinary public functions with returns simply omitted: a choice, worth a look.
